name: out-of-shelf-mode
description: A Mobi as one came to setup in a field log. Used 201 days ago on a right clock, on a 0.85 U/hr profile, with six boluses from its screen and an app (one stopped part-way) up to four hours before it was suspended and put on the shelf (a ShelfMode record). Woken 7 h 20 min ago: its clock restarted at 2008-01-01 with no record of it (NewDay, ArmInit and VersionInfo records), and about 4 minutes later was set to 2020-01-01 00:00 on the pump (a DateChange and a TimeChanged record). Suspended ever since, so the pump's clock reads 2020-01-01 07:16 and setup has to move it forward 6.9 years. Nothing given before the ShelfMode record may reach the host: setup's clock change, carried back to those boluses, dated them years ahead.
